items.claim: Luana Oliveira's previous competition has mostly consisted of debuting fighters or those with .500 records.
items.quote: she really hasn't beaten anybody good. For the most part, she was fighting girls that were debuting or with 500 one and one records.

items.claim: Simone de Silva had lost four straight MMA fights and double-digit straight fights if including boxing prior to fighting Oliveira.
items.quote: had also prior to that fight lost four straight fights in MMA and she has lost double-digit straight fights if you include her boxing career

items.claim: Manuel Sousa is a powerful striker with explosive punching combinations and a dangerous overhand.
items.quote: Manuel Sousa is an absolute powerhouse, a demolition man on the feet with explosive punching combinations, and I think just a winging overhand

items.claim: Richie Miranda has capable jiu-jitsu and durability.
items.quote: As much as I think Miranda has a chance with his jiu-jitsu and his durability

items.claim: Diego Ferreira has not won a fight in two years and is 41 years old.
items.quote: Diego Ferreira's got pretty good Muay Thai, and he's got high-level jiu-jitsu, but hasn't won in 2 years. He's 40 now.

items.claim: Billy Cornettilo has not won a fight in nearly three years and is moving up to lightweight.
items.quote: Billy Q hasn't won in nearly 3 years, but he is 37 as opposed to 41... moving up to lightweight.

items.claim: Diego Ferreira's chin is a red flag at this stage in his career.
items.quote: I think Diego Ferreira's chin is a red flag in 2026

items.claim: Quillin Salchaev is 6-foot tall with a 75-inch reach.
items.quote: Sal Khelb also 6-foot with a 75-inch reach.

items.claim: Mateusz Gamrot is not a damaging striker, a great ground-and-pound specialist, or a strong control threat who struggles to keep people down.
items.quote: he is not a damaging striker, nor is he a great ground-and-pound specialist or the best control control threat. We've seen him land a lot of takedowns, good chain wrestling, but sometimes he has a hard time keeping people down.

items.claim: Gigi Canudo is a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu world champion and submission ace who recently trained with Alexander Volkanovski.
items.quote: Gigi Canudo is a submission ace... dangerous grappler, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu world champ... recently she was even training with Volkanovski.
